name: Notebookcheck: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop specs
notes: Spec table for the GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop (GB203, GN22-X11): 10496 shaders, 24 GB GDDR7, 256-bit at 28000 MHz effective, 896 GB/s, TGP range 95-150 W plus 25 W Dynamic Boost (175 W peak). Secondary source; two independent write-ups agree on the 256-bit bus, which contradicts the 384-bit claim in the llama.cpp #15013 scoreboard row for this GPU.
